"AETHERIA – FANTASY MMORPG

Build a playable mobile-first fantasy MMORPG using detailed HD isometric pixel art, smooth animations and English UI. Build the actual game, not just a concept. Preserve working features.

WORLD: 8 regions with loading transitions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Add villages, quests, monsters, dungeons, bosses, hidden areas and respawns. Support walking, mounts and teleportation.

FACTIONS: Angels and Demons share the world but have unique appearances and wings. Choose faction at character creation. Wings unlock through quests or optional shop purchases, never drops or trading.

CLASSES: Warrior (Strength, sword, heavy armor), Mage (Intelligence, staff, robes), Archer (Dexterity, bow, light armor). Male/female characters, 3+ hairstyles and blue/green/brown eyes. Each class has normal attacks and ONE unique upgradeable main skill with 10 levels.

EQUIPMENT: Slots: weapon, helmet, chest, gloves, pants, boots, necklace, chain and earrings. Every class/faction has unique designs and restrictions. Everyone can farm, craft, buy and sell all equipment, but only the matching class/faction can equip it. Rarity visuals: Common/Grey same, Green improved, Blue/Epic similar, Legendary/Mythic/Divine increasingly spectacular. T3 normal, T2 small glow, T1 stronger glow. Effects must appear on characters.

DROPS AND FUSION: All equipment drops are T3. Drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. Epic+ never drop directly. Fusion requires 4 identical items (class, faction, type, rarity, tier): T3→T2→T1→next rarity T3. No random destruction. Legendary is crafted using rare materials and boss drops; Mythic requires 4 matching Legendary; Divine requires 4 matching Mythic. Divine T3→T2→T1 is possible.

Fusion prices (T3→T2 / T2→T1 / T1→next T3):
Common 2k/3.5k/5k; Grey 7.5k/10k/15k; Green 20k/30k/45k; Blue 60k/85k/120k; Epic 175k/250k/350k; Legendary 750k/1.5m/3m; Mythic 5m/10m/20m; Divine 25m/50m/no next rarity. Legendary crafting 5m, Mythic fusion 30m, Divine fusion 120m. All prices configurable.

BOSSES AND BONUSES: Bosses drop tradeable bonus stones. Maximum 3 bonuses per item. Warrior: Strength/Life/Crit; Mage: Intelligence/Life/Crit; Archer: Dexterity/Life/Crit. Enchanter NPC applies or changes bonuses using boss items and Gold. Stronger bosses drop better stones. No random destruction. Maximum total Critical Chance 50%.

NPCS AND ECONOMY: Starting village: Blacksmith, Potion Merchant, Teleporter, Quest NPC, Storage, Enchanter. Potions sold in packages of 100: Health/Mana small/medium/large 5k/15k/40k; Attack Speed/Movement Speed 10k/25k/60k. Teleport costs: same region 500, nearby 2k, medium 5k, far 10k, endgame 20k, dungeon 25k–50k. Target endgame income 100k Gold/hour. Gold comes from monsters, quests and NPC sales; player trades only transfer existing Gold. No durability or repairs. Market stall 5k per 24h, player-set prices, no mandatory market tax. Track Gold entering/leaving the economy.

SHOP: Gems, costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings, premium and offers. Test purchases only; prepare future Google Play Billing.

BUILD: Mobile-friendly, modular, central configuration for prices and drops. Implement playable systems, inventory, progression and saving where supported. Test all features, fix bugs and report completed work and missing online-backend requirements. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

BUILD THE GAME NOW.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()
import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-first fantasy MMORPG called "AETHERIA" in the existing `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround` workspace, with isometric pixel art, 8 regions, factions/classes, equipment/fusion, bosses, quests, economy, shop, and local saving.

## Requirements
- Actual playable game, not a concept; preserve working features.
- 8 regions with loading transitions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion, Tower of Eternity.
- Villages, quests, monsters, dungeons, bosses, hidden areas, respawns; walking, mounts, teleportation.
- Angels/Demons with unique appearance and wings; wings only via quests or shop, never drops/trading.
- Classes Warrior/Mage/Archer with Strength/Intelligence/Dexterity; male/female; 3+ hairstyles; blue/green/brown eyes.
- 9 equipment slots; class/faction restrictions; unique designs; rarity visuals; tier glow on characters.
- All equipment drops T3; Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%; Epic+ never directly drops.
- 4-identical-item fusion T3→T2→T1→next rarity T3; no random destruction; exact prices in request; configurable.
- Legendary crafting 5m, Mythic fusion 30m, Divine fusion 120m; Divine T3→T2→T1 possible.
- Boss bonus stones max 3/item; Warrior STR/Life/Crit, Mage INT/Life/Crit, Archer DEX/Life/Crit; Enchanter applies/changes using boss items + gold; no destruction; crit cap 50%.
- Starting village NPCs: Blacksmith, Potion Merchant, Teleporter, Quest NPC, Storage, Enchanter; market stall 5k/24h.
- Potion packages of 100 at specified prices; teleport prices 500/2k/5k/10k/20k; dungeon 25k–50k.
- Target endgame income 100k gold/hour; gold from monsters, quests, NPC sales; player trades only transfer existing gold; track gold entering/leaving.
- Shop: gems, costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings, premium, offers; test purchases only; prepare future Google Play Billing.
- Mobile-friendly, modular, central config for prices/drops; saving; test all features and report completed work and missing online-backend requirements.
- Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note briefly.

## Decisions
- Use vanilla ES modules + HTML5 canvas + localStorage (no framework/backend) because runtime supports static `index.html` deployment and local simulation is explicitly acceptable.
- Procedural HD pixel art rendered with crisp rectangles at low resolution, scaled with image smoothing disabled; no external art assets.
- Market buyers are explicitly labeled simulated; player-to-player trade, chat, guilds etc. documented as requiring a backend.
- Dungeons implemented as instanced runs of their host region with dedicated boss/elite populations.
- Fusion pricing/rarity/drop/teleport/economy values centralized in `src/config.js`.
- UI uses a single modal sheet system; panels re-render from state; save auto every 20s to `aetheria_save_v1`.
- Market buyer simulation uses varying delays (~45–225s) and adds gold via ledger as `market_sale`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `src/config.js` with all configurable prices, drops, fusion, teleports, potions, shop gem packs, economy targets.
- Created `src/utils.js` (RNG, formatting, EventBus, helpers).
- Created `src/data.js` with factions, classes, slots, rarities/tiers, 8 regions, monsters/bosses, NPCs, 6 dungeons, 23 quests, shop catalog, bonus stats, hair/eye options, how-to text.
- Created `src/state.js` with new game creation, localStorage save/load, derived stats, inventory/storage, equipment restrictions, fusion/crafting, bonuses/enchanting, quests, wings/mounts/cosmetics, teleport pricing, market, shop test purchases, economy ledger.
- Created `src/world.js` with deterministic region generation, villages, paths, water, props, NPCs, nodes, hidden chests, collision, enemy spawning/respawn.
- Created `src/sprites.js` with procedural pixel-art characters, wings, mounts, pets, monsters, NPCs, props, chests/nodes.
- Created `src/renderer.js` with isometric camera/ground pre-render, depth sorting, lighting, weather, effects, projectiles, loot, minimap, character preview.
- Created `src/audio.js` with procedural WebAudio sound effects.
- Created `src/game.js` with game loop, movement, combat, skills, enemy AI, boss slam, loot, death/respawn, interaction, travel/dungeons, input, HUD events.
- Created `index.html` with HUD, start screen, character creation, loading screen, modal, toasts, death overlay.
- Created `styles.css` with full mobile-first dark fantasy theme, responsive HUD/controls, panel components, shop/item/market styles.
- Created `src/ui.js` with start/creation flow, loading, HUD updates, joystick, toasts, all panels (inventory, character, quests, map, blacksmith, enchanter, potions, storage, market, shop, settings, economy, about, how-to, NPC), action routing.
- Syntax-checked `src/config.js`, `src/utils.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/state.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/sprites.js`, `src/renderer.js`, `src/game.js` successfully with `node --check`.
- Created `screenshots/` directory and `/tmp/opencode/plan.txt`.

### Active
- `src/main.js` is not yet created; page currently has no boot entrypoint.
- CSS/HTML integration and UI action wiring still need runtime testing.
- Known likely bugs to verify/fix:
  - `src/renderer.js` `drawLootSprite` was added; confirm syntax/behavior.
  - `src/game.js` references `game.questDef`, `interactLabel`, etc. from renderer; implemented.
  - `src/ui.js` potion labels/prices use new IDs `attack_small/medium/large` and `move_small/medium/large`, but `src/config.js` currently defines `attack_speed`, `attack_speed_l`, `move_speed`, `move_speed_l` — must reconcile.
  - `state.newGame` starter equipment duplication logic should be verified.
  - Mobile HUD overlap/quick action sizing needs screenshot review.
  - `drawCharacter` wings vertical offset while mounted may need adjustment.
  - `drawPropSprite` scaling was fixed but needs visual verification.
  - `state.char.bosses` double-increment was removed.
  - `this.el.potionCount` expression has incorrect precedence: `health_large || 0 + ...` — fix.
  - `this.el.btnMount.querySelector('span')` always sets same emoji (harmless but should improve).
  - `panelInventory` buttons use `data-act="item-detail"` on nested card; click delegation may find item-detail correctly.
  - Automatic refresh on `gold`/`gems` can rebuild modal while typing in market price; `isTyping()` used only for inventory/equipment events, not gold/gems.
  - `state.availableQuests` does not filter by region; UI shows all globally (acceptable).
  - `world.js` props `themeProps` fixed `grave` → `gravestone`.
  - UI `showHowTo()` pre-game sets panel without `game`; fine but not restored elegantly.
  - `renderCharacterPreview` called on title preview and creation preview; needs boot invocation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js` to boot UI + state + game, wire `createGame`/`continueGame` callbacks, handle resize, loading, autosave, visibility/unload save.
2. Reconcile potion config keys with UI/game expectations (`attack_small/medium/large`, `move_small/medium/large`) and fix UI potion-count precedence bug.
3. Start server (`start.sh`/static) and run browser smoke tests with Playwright/chromium; check console errors, canvas rendering, start/creation/loading/gameplay.
4. Exercise core flows: character creation, movement, combat, loot, equip, fusion, enchanting, quests, teleport/dungeon, market, shop, save/reload.
5. Take desktop/mobile screenshots, inspect visual quality, fix HUD/panel/layout issues.
6. Update `README.md` with run instructions, feature status, assumptions, and explicitly list missing online-backend requirements; report completed work and missing multiplayer backend.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: page skeleton, HUD, start/create/loading/modal/toast DOM.
- `styles.css`: full UI theme and responsive mobile layout.
- `src/main.js`: missing boot entrypoint; highest priority.
- `src/config.js`: all economy/drop/fusion/teleport/shop pricing; reconcile potion keys.
- `src/data.js`: game content — regions, classes, monsters, quests, shop, NPCs, dungeons.
- `src/state.js`: save/load, items, fusion, enchanting, quests, market, shop, economy.
- `src/game.js`: gameplay loop/combat/travel; verify runtime integration.
- `src/renderer.js`: isometric rendering, loot, minimap, character preview.
- `src/ui.js`: all panels/actions/HUD; runtime wiring and bug fixes.
- `src/world.js`: map generation/collision/spawns.
- `src/sprites.js`: procedural pixel-art visuals.
- `src/utils.js`: shared RNG/formatting/event bus.
- `src/audio.js`: WebAudio SFX.
- `README.md`: currently only OMGithub template; needs project documentation.
- `start.sh` / `startup.sh` / `capture.sh`: runtime scripts; `start.sh` expects `$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Working dir is a git repo with only initial README/OMGithub files and untracked new game files. Changes are uncommitted.
- Runtime starts static HTML directly (`projectType` returns `html` if `index.html` exists); no npm build needed.
- `node` v22.23.4, `chromium`, `google-chrome`, `playwright-cli` available. `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime`.
- `playwright-cli` can open/screenshot; README says use preinstalled headed Chromium, Xvfb display, SwiftShader; screenshot to `screenshots/`.
- The app uses `localStorage` key `aetheria_save_v1`; no backend or real multiplayer.
- Current UI assumes `State.hasSave()` static and callbacks `createGame(draft)` / `continueGame()`.
- `src/ui.js` imports `this.state.sfx` in creation change handler (`this.state.sfx?.play?.('ui')`) but `State` has no `sfx`; harmless optional call, should use game sfx after binding.
- Spec contradictions resolved as follows: Epic T1 fusion may advance to Legendary T3 at 350k; Legendary→Mythic uses 30m special; Mythic→Divine uses 120m special; Legendary can also be crafted with 3 Primordial Cores + 5 rare region materials + 5m gold. Document as assumptions if needed.
- Must explicitly report: no real multiplayer; market buyers are simulated; no cloud save/auth/trading/auction/chat/guilds; Google Play Billing is a prepared stub with test-only purchases.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-first fantasy MMORPG called "AETHERIA" in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, with isometric pixel art, 8 regions, factions/classes, equipment/fusion, bosses, quests, economy, shop, and local saving.

## Requirements
- Actual playable game, not a concept; preserve working features.
- 8 regions with loading transitions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion, Tower of Eternity.
- Villages, quests, monsters, dungeons, bosses, hidden areas, respawns; walking, mounts, teleportation.
- Angels/Demons with unique appearance and wings; wings only via quests or shop, never drops/trading.
- Classes Warrior/Mage/Archer with Strength/Intelligence/Dexterity; male/female; 3+ hairstyles; blue/green/brown eyes.
- 9 equipment slots; class/faction restrictions; unique designs; rarity visuals; tier glow on characters.
- All equipment drops T3; Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%; Epic+ never directly drops.
- 4-identical-item fusion T3→T2→T1→next rarity T3; no random destruction; exact prices in request; configurable.
- Legendary crafting 5m, Mythic fusion 30m, Divine fusion 120m; Divine T3→T2→T1 possible.
- Boss bonus stones max 3/item; Warrior STR/Life/Crit, Mage INT/Life/Crit, Archer DEX/Life/Crit; Enchanter applies/changes using boss items + gold; no destruction; crit cap 50%.
- Starting village NPCs: Blacksmith, Potion Merchant, Teleporter, Quest NPC, Storage, Enchanter; market stall 5k/24h.
- Potion packages of 100 at specified prices; teleport prices 500/2k/5k/10k/20k; dungeon 25k–50k.
- Target endgame income 100k gold/hour; gold from monsters, quests, NPC sales; player trades only transfer existing gold; track gold entering/leaving.
- Shop: gems, costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings, premium, offers; test purchases only; prepare future Google Play Billing.
- Mobile-friendly, modular, central config for prices/drops; saving; test all features and report completed work and missing online-backend requirements.
- Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note briefly.

## Decisions
- Use vanilla ES modules + HTML5 canvas + localStorage (no framework/backend); local single-player simulation is acceptable.
- Procedural HD pixel art rendered at low resolution with image smoothing disabled; no external art assets.
- Market buyers are explicitly labeled simulated; real multiplayer/trading/chat/guilds documented as requiring a backend.
- Dungeons are instanced runs of their host region with dedicated boss/elite populations.
- Fusion pricing/rarity/drop/teleport/economy values centralized in `src/config.js`.
- UI uses a single modal sheet; panels re-render from state; save auto every 20s to `aetheria_save_v1`.
- Market buyer simulation uses delays (~45–225s) and adds gold via ledger as `market_sale`.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/config.js` contains all configurable prices, drops, fusion, teleports, potions, shop gem packs, economy targets.
- `src/utils.js` (RNG, formatting, EventBus, helpers), `src/data.js` (factions, classes, slots, rarities/tiers, 8 regions, monsters/bosses, NPCs, 6 dungeons, 23 quests, shop catalog, bonus stats, hair/eye options, how-to text).

- `src/world.js` with deterministic region generation, villages, paths, water, props, NPCs, nodes, hidden chests, collision, enemy spawning/respawn.
- `src/sprites.js` with procedural pixel-art characters, wings, mounts, pets, monsters, NPCs, props, chests/nodes.
- `src/renderer.js` with isometric camera/ground pre-render, depth sorting, lighting, weather, effects, projectiles, loot, minimap, character preview.
- `src/audio.js` with procedural WebAudio sound effects.
- `src/game.js` with game loop, movement, combat, skills, enemy AI, boss slam, loot, death/respawn, interaction, travel/dungeons, input, HUD events.
- `index.html` with HUD, start screen, character creation, loading screen, modal, toasts, death overlay; favicon added.
- `styles.css` with full mobile-first dark fantasy theme and responsive HUD/controls; fixed `.select-item` stacking, mobile toast placement, and toast-over-modal behavior.
- `src/ui.js` with start/creation flow, loading, HUD updates, joystick, toasts, all panels, action routing; quest availability filtered to current region.

"AETHERIA – FANTASY MMORPG

Build a playable mobile-first fantasy MMORPG using detailed HD isometric pixel art, smooth animations and English UI. Build the actual game, not just a concept. Preserve working features.

WORLD: 8 regions with loading transitions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Add villages, quests, monsters, dungeons, bosses, hidden areas and respawns. Support walking, mounts and teleportation.

FACTIONS: Angels and Demons share the world but have unique appearances and wings. Choose faction at character creation. Wings unlock through quests or optional shop purchases, never drops or trading.

CLASSES: Warrior (Strength, sword, heavy armor), Mage (Intelligence, staff, robes), Archer (Dexterity, bow, light armor). Male/female characters, 3+ hairstyles and blue/green/brown eyes. Each class has normal attacks and ONE unique upgradeable main skill with 10 levels.

EQUIPMENT: Slots: weapon, helmet, chest, gloves, pants, boots, necklace, chain and earrings. Every class/faction has unique designs and restrictions. Everyone can farm, craft, buy and sell all equipment, but only the matching class/faction can equip it. Rarity visuals: Common/Grey same, Green improved, Blue/Epic similar, Legendary/Mythic/Divine increasingly spectacular. T3 normal, T2 small glow, T1 stronger glow. Effects must appear on characters.

DROPS AND FUSION: All equipment drops are T3. Drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. Epic+ never drop directly. Fusion requires 4 identical items (class, faction, type, rarity, tier): T3→T2→T1→next rarity T3. No random destruction. Legendary is crafted using rare materials and boss drops; Mythic requires 4 matching Legendary; Divine requires 4 matching Mythic. Divine T3→T2→T1 is possible.

Fusion prices (T3→T2 / T2→T1 / T1→next T3):
Common 2k/3.5k/5k; Grey 7.5k/10k/15k; Green 20k/30k/45k; Blue 60k/85k/120k; Epic 175k/250k/350k; Legendary 750k/1.5m/3m; Mythic 5m/10m/20m; Divine 25m/50m/no next rarity. Legendary crafting 5m, Mythic fusion 30m, Divine fusion 120m. All prices configurable.

BOSSES AND BONUSES: Bosses drop tradeable bonus stones. Maximum 3 bonuses per item. Warrior: Strength/Life/Crit; Mage: Intelligence/Life/Crit; Archer: Dexterity/Life/Crit. Enchanter NPC applies or changes bonuses using boss items and Gold. Stronger bosses drop better stones. No random destruction. Maximum total Critical Chance 50%.

NPCS AND ECONOMY: Starting village: Blacksmith, Potion Merchant, Teleporter, Quest NPC, Storage, Enchanter. Potions sold in packages of 100: Health/Mana small/medium/large 5k/15k/40k; Attack Speed/Movement Speed 10k/25k/60k. Teleport costs: same region 500, nearby 2k, medium 5k, far 10k, endgame 20k, dungeon 25k–50k. Target endgame income 100k Gold/hour. Gold comes from monsters, quests and NPC sales; player trades only transfer existing Gold. No durability or repairs. Market stall 5k per 24h, player-set prices, no mandatory market tax. Track Gold entering/leaving the economy.

SHOP: Gems, costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings, premium and offers. Test purchases only; prepare future Google Play Billing.

BUILD: Mobile-friendly, modular, central configuration for prices and drops. Implement playable systems, inventory, progression and saving where supported. Test all features, fix bugs and report completed work and missing online-backend requirements. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

BUILD THE GAME NOW.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
